text: ‘Global inequality is caused by capitalist exploitation of developing countries.’ Evaluate this view.
OR
‘Global migration has more positive than negative consequences for both migrants and host
countries.’ Evaluate this view. [35]
Section B: Media
EITHER
‘The media has a significant influence on how people behave.’ Evaluate this view. [35]
OR
‘The media still portrays women in traditional gender roles.’ Evaluate this view. [35]
Section C: Religion
EITHER
‘Religion encourages people to accept oppression.’ Evaluate this view. [35]
OR
‘Religious fundamentalism is best explained as a response to secularisation.’ Evaluate this view.
